title: Step 2 - Preparing Data: Creating Training and Test Sets in R for ML Models

cues.en: Instructor: Okay, and so now we imported the catools library that is going to make a good split of the data sent into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 現在已匯入 caTools，準備把資料切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: So, now let's make the split.
So, remember in Python, for those of you who followed the Python tutorial, we used random state equals zero so that we get the same results.
cues.zh: 有看 Python 教學的朋友應該記得，之前使用 random_state=0，讓結果一致。

cues.en: Well, here it's gonna be the same.
We're gonna set a seed to have the same results.
cues.zh: 要設定隨機種子，取得相同結果。

cues.en: Only we're gonna do it now, we're not gonna wait to be in the function in the library that makes the split.
cues.zh: 只是這裡先設定，不會等到切分函式裡再指定。

cues.en: So to do it, we have to set the same seed.
And so we can type set.seed, and then parenthesis.
We can choose any number we want.
It can be this number, you know, that's a seed.
cues.zh: 例如這個數字，就是種子。

cues.en: If we both choose this number, we'll have the same results.
cues.zh: 如果我們選相同數字，就會得到相同結果。

cues.en: But let's choose a more simple number.
Let's choose for example, 123.
And now let's make the split.
It's not as simple as in Python where we make it in one line.
cues.zh: 不像 Python 一行就完成，這裡稍微不同。

cues.en: Here, we're gonna have to prepare the method that we are going to call split.
cues.zh: 先準備一個命名為 split 的物件，

cues.en: That is, the method that is going to make the split of your data set into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 保存將資料分成訓練集與測試集的切分結果。

cues.en: Equals, and then sample.split.
Okay, now if you want we can press F1 to see what we have to input.
cues.zh: 如果需要，可以按 F1 看看要傳入什麼。

cues.en: Okay, so, seed, sample.split, split data into test and train set.
cues.zh: 這裡是 sample.split 的說明，將資料拆成測試集與訓練集。

cues.en: Let's see the arguments.
The first argument is Y.
Som that's not the same argument that we had to put for Python.
cues.zh: 這和 Python 的輸入不同。

cues.en: In Python we had to put both the matrix of features X and the dependent variable vector Y.
cues.zh: Python 必須同時傳入特徵矩陣 X，以及依變數向量 y。

cues.en: Here we only have to put Y.
On here we're gonna take Y the following way, we're gonna type dataset$Purchased because your dependent variable is Purchased.
cues.zh: 這裡用 dataset$Purchased 取得 Y，因為依變數就是 Purchased。

cues.en: Okay, so that's okay for the first parameter.
And then what is the second parameter?
It's split ratio.
Okay, so split ratio.
Let's write SplitRatio here.
And so split ratio is just a percentage of the observations that you want to put in your training set.
cues.zh: 它表示要放進訓練集的觀測值百分比。

cues.en: So, let's be careful.
In Python, we put the percentage for the test set.
cues.zh: Python 指定的是測試集比例。

cues.en: And here we have to put it for the training set.
cues.zh: 這裡則要指定訓練集比例。

cues.en: So, remember in Python we chose 20% for the test set.
cues.zh: 先前 Python 選擇 20% 作為測試集。

cues.en: So here, logically for the training set, we will choose 0.8.
cues.zh: 因此，這裡訓練集自然要設為 0.8。

cues.en: Okay, so what will this split return?
So, it will return true or false for each of your observations.
cues.zh: 它會替每一筆觀測值傳回 TRUE 或 FALSE。

cues.en: That means that each observation will have either true or false.
cues.zh: 也就是每筆都對應一個布林值。

cues.en: And it's gonna be true if this observation was chosen to go to the training set, and false if the observation was chosen to go to the test set.
cues.zh: 被選進訓練集的觀測值是 TRUE，被選進測試集的則是 FALSE。

cues.en: So, let's have a look.
Let's select this.
Command + Control + Enter to execute.
cues.zh: 按 Command 或 Control 加 Enter 執行。

cues.en: And here it is.
We have the split here.
So, now let's go to the console and write, "split."
Right, Enter.
All right, you see that you have 10 values.
And so true means that the observation goes to the training set and false means that the observation goes to the test set.
cues.zh: TRUE 表示這筆進入訓練集，FALSE 表示進入測試集。

cues.en: Okay, so now what we have to do is to create the training set and the test set separately.
cues.zh: 接著必須分別建立訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: So, we're gonna do this.
We'll type training_set, which is gonna be the name of our training set actually, let's make it simple.
cues.zh: 輸入 training_set，直接作為訓練集名稱，簡單明確。

cues.en: So, training_set equals subset parenthesis.
And here is the first argument, we put dataset, because it's a, the training set is a subset of the data set.
cues.zh: 第一個引數是 dataset，因為訓練集是原始資料集的子集。

cues.en: And here we will specify that we want the split == true.
And that's it.
Okay, so that's it for the training set.
Now let's copy this line.
Paste it here.
And here we're gonna change training_set to test_set.
And of course we're gonna change split == true to false because the test sets are the observations for which the splits equals false.
cues.zh: 當然，也把 split == TRUE 改成 FALSE，因為測試集就是 split 等於 FALSE 的觀測值。

cues.en: And now we're ready.
We are ready to make the split of the data set into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 可以把資料集拆成訓練集與測試集了。

cues.en: So, let's execute these lines.
Command + Control + Enter to execute.
cues.zh: 按 Command 或 Control 加 Enter。

cues.en: And here we go.
Test set and training sets are created.
cues.zh: test_set 與 training_set 已經建立。

cues.en: Let's look at them.
So, let's click on the training set here and the test set.
Let's move that here and that here.
cues.zh: 把這個移過來，另一個也移過來。

cues.en: Okay, let's look at the training set first.
Okay, we see that we have eight observations.
Okay, good.
And now let's look at the test set.
Now we can clearly see that we have two observations with six and nine, perfect.
cues.zh: 清楚看到兩筆觀測值，原始索引是 6 與 9，很好。

cues.en: Okay, so that's it for this tutorial.
You now know how to split your data set into a training set and a test set.
cues.zh: 現在你已知道如何切分訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: This is a must-do in any machine learning model.
cues.zh: 這是任何機器學習模型都必須注意的步驟。

cues.en: You have to test the performance of your machine learning model into a separate test set.
cues.zh: 必須在獨立測試集上，評估模型效能。

cues.en: So, congratulations.
Now you are almost ready to begin the journey of making exciting machine learning models.
cues.zh: 你已幾乎準備好，開始建立有趣的機器學習模型。

cues.en: We just have one thing to do left, feature scaling.
cues.zh: 只剩最後一件事：特徵縮放。

cues.en: You'll understand in the next tutorial why it's so important to do this.
cues.zh: 下一堂課會說明，為什麼它這麼重要。

cues.en: So, I look forward to seeing you there.
And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
